d: Chirag Paswan On Modi Power: ostreliya ke think taink lovi instityut ki Asia Power Index 2026 riport men pradhanmantri narendr modi ko dusra sabse prabhavshali kshetriy neta mana gaya hai. piem modi ko mile is antarrashtriy samman par kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne khushi aur garv jataya. unhonne kaha ki ek bhartiy hone ke nate yah unke lie garv ki bat hai. chirag ke mutabik, pradhanmantri modi ki samaveshi soch, garib kalyan, vikas ko prathmikta aur vaishvik manchon par netritv kshamta ko duniya ne saraha hai. unhonne piem modi ko is uplabdhi ke lie badhaee aur shubhkamnaen bhi din.
